summary: Quiet residential bend with homes 12-17 m away and a steep grade.

drivers.seclusion: Dense housing all round; nearest buildings 12-14 m away, so neighbours would notice.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed street; wide grass verge on the west side gives room to pull off.
drivers.traffic: Quiet cul-de-sac style street, light local traffic.
drivers.convention: Vehicles park on the street, but no camping convention.

flags: Mapped gate 60 m away, not on the only access
sun_shade: Mixed: tree canopy on the east side, open verge on the west gets afternoon sun.

best_section.where: West kerb just south of the corner, beside the wide grass verge
